annotations.title: Ask the owner to replace a stored credential

description: Ask the owner to type a new value for one of the selected Mac’s stored credentials (an API key or token FrontierStack keeps, such as openai, anthropic, cloudflare or stripe) on a secure FrontierStack page, for example after a key has leaked. The value goes from the owner’s browser straight to the Mac, sealed to it and confirmed with a passkey the Mac created; it never passes through the AI client or the conversation, and this tool neither accepts nor returns it. The first call returns a link for the owner (a URL elicitation where the client supports it) with a short code they can compare; a repeat call with the same arguments returns the outcome once they have finished. Requires web approvals and credential entry to be turned on for that Mac.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

reason.description: Why, in a few words, shown to the owner on the page (for example "the key was pasted into a chat").

service.description: The credential to replace: its FrontierStack id (for example openai, anthropic, cloudflare, stripe, github) or the service name.

name: replace_credential
